hook: Annual inflation hit 3.7 percent in September, up from August.

sections.voiceover: Annual inflation hit 3.7 percent in September, up from August.
sections.visual_cue: Bold text overlay showing the 3.7 percent annual inflation rate on a dark background.
b_roll: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data release screen

sections.voiceover: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers increased 0.6 percent. CNBC reported gasoline prices climbed.
sections.visual_cue: Line graph showing the Consumer Price Index monthly climb and gasoline price increase.
b_roll: Gas station price board showing fuel costs

sections.voiceover: Energy costs spiked five point two percent, but gasoline surged nine point one percent.
sections.visual_cue: Bar chart highlighting the 5.2 percent energy cost increase.

sections.voiceover: CNBC reported Core CPI climbed zero point three percent. CNBC reported that Core CPI posted an annual reading of two point six percent.
sections.visual_cue: Detailed breakdown table displaying the 9.1 percent gasoline surge and 2.6 percent Core CPI.

sections.voiceover: August annual CPI sat at 3.4 percent according to the official report.
sections.visual_cue: Comparison graphic showing August 3.4 percent versus September 3.7 percent annual CPI.
